name: splice-equivalence-tests
body: The e2e equivalence surface: `tests/splice_e2e.rs`'s fixture, seed/table oracles and publish path, and `tests/project_cmd_e2e.rs`'s merge round trip. The fixture graph carries authored/transient rows, and the surface exercises a spec-only splice delta against a full rebuild, a database seeded with a dropped authored row across a durable commit, and a spec-only merge round trip whose main `db.lbug` carries the merged authored row.
